cleo: Quick: partner SEV flow for CloudMart (marketplace + SI). Need a tiny, shareable process for their NOC.

marc: Suggest 3-step: 1) Triage in shared channel, 2) Phone bridge + PD, 3) War room if >15m. Keep public posts gated by legal.

anya: Please include timezone dial-ins and SI contact block. Also note which alerts should auto-open PD (cpu_spike, kvcache_eviction).

liz: CloudMart prefers Redwood to start the phone bridge for SEV1. We'll give their oncall CSV.

cleo: Draft below, please react if ok. I'll pin and export to partners runbook.

cleo: ```
PARTNER SEV QUICKFLOW  CloudMart
- SEV1 (0-15m): post one-line in #partners-cloudmart, ping @eng-oncall. Trigger PD service "cloudmart-partner-sev". Caller dials Redwood conduit (+1-555-9000), reads script, confirm Zoom link.
- SEV1 (15m): ops-bot creates private #pm-cloudmart-sev1-<ts>, invite partner oncall, SI lead, marketplace ops, legal opt-in.
- SEV2/3: triage in channel, open ticket if >45m.
- Postmortem: joint within 72h.
```

pd-bot: PD service created: cloudmart-partner-sev (store keys in secrets).

ops-bot: Auto-create enabled for #pm-cloudmart-sev1-<ts>. Zoom template: zoom.link/cloudmart.

marc: I'll add the dial-in fallbacks for EMEA/APAC. anya: can you assemble SI CSV?

anya: On it. Expect file by EOD.

cleo: Good. Dry-run Friday 08:00 PT in #partners-cloudmart.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 1793303600: dry-run in #partners-cloudmart 08:00 PT.
